name: BunniHubLogic withdrawal rounding reserve depletion
summary: BunniHubLogic.withdraw() rounded the pool's idle-balance update in the withdrawer's favour. Dozens of tiny withdrawals burned negligible shares but shrank the pool's accounted active balance, so swaps priced against the distorted balances and later withdrawals took far more reserves than the burned shares were worth.
notes: The Unichain weETH/ETH leg (04:35:32 UTC) came three minutes before the Ethereum USDC/USDT leg, so it is the anchor. The hub is a singleton and each pool is its own context (rule 11): the age runs from deployBunniToken creating the exploited pool, not from the hub deployment.

Victims are the pools' Euler vaults (underlying redeemed by the hub) and the Uniswap v4 PoolManager (raw balances). loss.mjs has no Unichain prices, so Unichain weETH and ETH use DefiLlama's Ethereum weETH and ETH quotes at the anchor; the USDT includes the 9,000 USDT flash-loan fee paid from the drain.
